The outcome holds by accident (core plugin.json, mcp.json and hooks.json are never read, so nothing loads twice), but there is no dual-package detection: no plugin detail says the package also carries a core manifest (§1.3.1 SHOULD). Needed: a form classifier that sees the root plugin.json with a canonical core $schema and flags `alsoCore` on the loaded plugin.

agent-plugins does not implement the core Agent Plugins form. A directory with only a root plugin.json carrying a canonical core $schema loads as a Claude Code plugin without a manifest (or not at all without a fallback name) instead of as a core package (§1.2 item 1, §1.3 table row 3). Needed: (1) a form decision before any component read, per the §1.3 table, keyed on the canonical core $schema identifiers (core §5.2); (2) a core loader implementing core §4-§5 (core manifest, mcp.json, hooks.json, core containment §4.1); (3) the dual-package note of J1.2.
